# KSS (凱士士) conduit parts – catalog pages from the owner (2026-11-27)

- `KSS_p152_PAQ_BGQ_conduit_adaptor.pdf` – 0616 快速型浪管固定頭 (easy-type conduit adaptor), NYLON 66, with locknut.
  PAQ series (PG thread, for PA nylon conduit), used in v14:

  | conduit | adaptor | thread | thread OD | sheet hole |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | PA-17 | PAQ-1716 | PG16 | 22.5 | 22.5 +0.2 |
  | PA-23 | PAQ-2321 | PG21 | 28.3 | 28.3 +0.3 |
  | PA-29 | PAQ-2929 | PG29 | 37.0 | 37.0 +0.3 |
  | PA-36 | PAQ-3636 | PG36 | 47.0 | 47.0 +0.3 |

  The page gives thread size and hole only; the adaptor body length / diameter in the model are estimated (body ~1.2 x thread OD long).
  No 90 deg elbow on this page.
- `KSS_p155_CF_conduit.pdf` – 0621 CF hard PE conduit for building grout (BG adaptors). Not used on the machine (not PA, not for moving runs).
- Still missing: the PA nylon conduit page (PA-17 / 23 / 29 / 36 inner / outer diameter, bend radius) and the fixing base (浪管固定座) page.
  The model keeps NW17 / 23 / 29 / 36 outer diameters 21.2 / 28.5 / 34.5 / 42.5 until then.
